<thought>We will search for templates that form sulfonamides and break acyl chloride (as proxy for sulfonyl chloride). Use target SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O","functional_groups_formed":["sulfonamides"],"functional_groups_broken":["acyl chloride"],"limit":5}</action_input>
